requirement.value: Butcher or Vivisectionist (Chimerist) mastery + Fleshcraft and Spell Mimic

system.description: When you use Fleshcraft on an NPC, the GM must reveal every spell it knows. If it knows one or more, you may learn one of them as a Chimerist spell of your own — even if that NPC's Species is not among those Spell Mimic normally allows.
